sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Base model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: exact pretrained-only Base card still publishes a nominal 9B language model with a vision encoder and MTP, but no active-parameter count. Generic post-training and MoE passages conflict with its variant-specific description and configuration.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Base configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; 32 dense text layers alternate three linear-attention layers with one full-attention layer, with vision and one MTP layer. No activated-parameter specification is present.

sources.title: Official checkpoint metadata and Safetensors parameter count
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 API retrieval at revision 68c46c4b3498877f3ef123c856ecfde50c39f404 reports 9653100528 BF16 plus 3840 F32 parameters, totaling 9653104368; last modified April 23, 2026. The total matches the prior independently recorded tensor-header sum; no shards were downloaded in this re-audit.

sources.title: Official checkpoint index and linked tensor headers
sources.evidence: All four linked shard headers were read with byte ranges and tensor-shape products summed: language backbone 7936684544, LM head 1017118720, vision 456010480, MTP 243290624; total 9653104368.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Base license
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository distributes the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Base checkpoint tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: Template renders text, images, video, tool calls and an enable_thinking branch; this establishes template syntax, not instruction-tuned behavior of the pretrained-only weights.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository news and developer attribution
sources.evidence: The renamed official Qwen3.5 repository attributes development to Alibaba and dates availability of the 9B/4B/2B/0.8B series to March 2, 2026; the entry does not explicitly identify the Base variants.

sources.title: Exact Base checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Initial repository commit February 26; checkpoint folder upload February 27; subsequent changes before March 2. Commit timestamps do not establish when the repository became public.

sources.title: Qwen-Scope: Decoding Intelligence, Unleashing Potential
sources.evidence: The search-indexed official April 29 article explicitly places the Qwen3.5-9B-Base backbone in its Dense group. Indexed text was available; opening the live JavaScript page returned no article text.

sources.title: Initial Base repository tree
sources.evidence: The February 26 initial revision contains only .gitattributes and a 31-byte README, with no model weights.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B post-trained card and comparison tables
sources.evidence: Checked October 27 as a targeted exact-size comparison source: explicitly names Qwen3.5-9B-Base as base_model and gives nominal 9B language-model parameters. Its language and vision benchmark tables contain no activated-parameter row or column.

sources.title: Qwen-Scope technical report, Table 1
sources.evidence: Checked October 27: the later first-party comparison table explicitly includes the Qwen3.5-9B-Base backbone in the Dense group, with 32 layers and hidden size 4096. Its columns describe SAE width, expansion and top-k; these are not active model parameter counts, and the report supplies no active count for this backbone.

sources.title: Secondary registry active-count claim and provenance
sources.evidence: Targeted exact-variant searches surfaced 9.65B active, but the record expressly derives it from all-parameters-active-in-dense-model. Rejected as a secondary architecture inference, not a Qwen disclosure. The linked primary card and API provide no active count.

sources.title: Qwen March 2 small-model and Base release announcement
sources.evidence: Official X syndication API provides original author Alibaba_Qwen and timestamp 2026-03-02T13:18:56Z. Its excerpt is truncated. Full original post retrieved through FxTwitter includes explicit release of the Base models alongside 0.8B, 2B, 4B and 9B, with links to the official model collections. Tongyi Lab's original newsletter independently reproduces the same Base-release text.

sources.title: Tongyi Lab original weekly release announcement
sources.evidence: Full newsletter accessed through web reader. Its Qwen3.5 Small Model Series section names 0.8B, 2B, 4B and 9B and explicitly says it is also releasing Base models; links to official Hugging Face and ModelScope collections. This corroborates full text of Qwen March 2 post, not a March 6 release date.

sources.title: Exact 9B Base preparation history
sources.evidence: Reopened original history: empty repo February 26, checkpoint upload February 27, team README PR February 27/28 and processor update March 2. These preparation dates do not override the public Base release announcement.

name.note: Catalog spacing preserves the official Qwen3.5-9B-Base identity.

developer.note: The official Qwen repository identifies the Qwen team within Alibaba Group.

family.note: Qwen3.5 is a member of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: February 26 is repository creation and February 27 is weight upload; the original March 2 Qwen announcement explicitly includes the Base models in the small-series release. The previously accessed truncated post omitted that sentence; the full post and Tongyi Lab newsletter resolve the Base identity.

open_weights.note: Exact Base checkpoint weights and tensor headers are publicly accessible.

license.note: Verified against the license file distributed with this checkpoint.

parameters_b.note: Fresh official checkpoint metadata confirms the complete 9.653104368B total and agrees with the prior tensor census. Preserve the exact component breakdown; the developer nominal 9B label is scoped to the language model.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-card, configuration and targeted first-party comparison-table checks found no separately published active count. The later Qwen-Scope table identifies a dense backbone but reports SAE properties; secondary dense-equals-total claims do not establish the developer convention. No total or non-embedding count is substituted.

architecture.note: Dense feed-forward network with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full-attention layers and a vision encoder; exact configuration and Qwen-Scope classification override generic MoE wording.

context_window.note: Native maximum positions and tokenizer limit agree at 262144; optional context extension is not the native limit.

modalities.note: The exact configuration supplies vision/image/video inputs and conditional text generation; the template implements all three input types.

reasoning.note: The base weights are pretrained-only. A thinking branch in the supplied fine-tuning-compatible template does not establish a supported reasoning mode or verify its absence.

tool_call.note: Tool serialization exists in the supplied template, but the base card does not establish trained tool-calling support or its absence. Clear the unsupported false assertion.

description.value: Pre-trained Qwen3.5 base checkpoint for fine-tuning and research, without instruction tuning
description.note: The variant-specific pretrained-only statement supports this description despite the contradictory generic training-stage bullet.

patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 9.653104368B parameters, including 8.953803264B language model with output head (nominally 9B), 0.456010480B vision and 0.243290624B MTP. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. Dense FFNs accompany hybrid DeltaNet/full attention. Base weights are pretrained-only; generic card claims and template branches do not establish trained reasoning or tool capabilities. Qwen announced release of the small-series Base checkpoints on March 2, 2026. The February 26 repository creation and February 27 weight upload were preparation dates.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the verified 9.653104368B complete-checkpoint total and exact components; fresh official metadata agrees with the prior tensor census. The nominal 9B language-model specification remains explicit. Exact-model and targeted later first-party table searches found no published active count, so active_parameters_b remains explicitly null/undisclosed. Other audited fields are unchanged. The release-date re-audit verifies March 2, 2026: the full original Qwen release announcement explicitly includes Base models, corroborated by Tongyi Lab's weekly release post.
